
# 6. Review of Second Tranche Priorities

Consistent with the project plan, second-tranche requirements will be reviewed during the fourth quarter of Year 1 before commencement of WP4.2. The review will evaluate feedback from workflow users, workshop participants, ecosystem experts, and project partners to validate that Year 2 priorities continue to address the most important user needs. [\[Attachment...oject Plan \| PDF\]](https://unsw-my.sharepoint.com/personal/z3529065_ad_unsw_edu_au/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/Attachment%201%20-%20PLT019%20Project%20Plan.pdf)

The review will consider:

### User Adoption

* Which workflows are being reused?
* Which user groups are actively engaged?
* Which ecosystems are generating the greatest demand?

### Technical Performance

* Workflow reproducibility
* Data interoperability
* Platform performance
* FAIR compliance

### Community Feedback

* Feedback collected through workshops
* Community engagement activities
* User stories
* Steering Committee recommendations

### Emerging Use Cases

Potential additions may include:

* ecosystem accounting workflows
* TNFD-related reporting workflows
* Green Status of Ecosystems workflows
* ecosystem restoration workflows
* additional ecosystem realms and ecosystem types

Any approved changes to second-tranche priorities will be documented through the project's governance and change-control processes and reflected in the Year 2 delivery plan.
